narrative.overview:
This lander extends the actual Studio Three identity chosen by the user: the original transparent logo, Gotham and Trade Gothic typography, monochrome training photography, and the blue/orange/lime brand marks. Bold condensed headlines and generous section spacing give the page a confident studio presence; restrained body text keeps the next step understandable.

Scope is this landing page and its inquiry-completion page. Evidence is `src/index.css`, `src/pages/LandingPage.tsx`, `src/pages/ThankYouPage.tsx`, `src/components/InquiryForm.tsx`, the direction contract in `index.html`, and the final desktop/mobile renders. This records implemented visual decisions, not a new identity proposal.
keyCharacteristics: Ink and paper sections with purposeful brand-color accents.
Human training photography with readable text separation.

rules.name: The Original Mark Rule
rules.body: Use `public/studio-three-logo.png` unchanged. Do not redraw, recolor, or substitute typeset lettering for the user's logo.

rules.name: The Brand Pairing Rule
rules.body: Keep condensed Trade Gothic for editorial emphasis and actions, regular Trade Gothic for form titles, and Gotham for readable supporting information.

rules.name: The Intent First Rule
rules.body: Responsive changes preserve headline hierarchy, visible faces, readable prose, and access to the founding-membership action.

dos: Do preserve the supplied logo and local brand font families.
Do retain monochrome photography, visible faces, and deliberate contrast behind copy.
Do use the existing square lime action, paper panel, and white field primitives.
Do preserve responsive reading order, keyboard focus, field errors, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't redraw the logo or replace the brand fonts with an invented identity.
Don't add decorative color strips or repeated invitation blocks.
Don't add shadows or rounded pill treatments to these flat primitives.
Don't make headline impact depend on illegible mobile supporting text.
